card.name: Digit after the decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a decimal point in a number such as 7.5 or 9.8, most often 5 after a 7, 8 or 9. It appears in doses, concentrations, weights and cartridge sizes.

modes.label: Decimal in a dose or concentration
modes.description: The digit after the point in a strength, volume or lab value, usually before mg, mL or g/dL.
modes.example: 6.67 mg/16.67 mg per mL solution and 9.<<5>> mg/mL to 30 mg/mL

modes.label: Decimal in a size or weight
modes.description: The digit after the point in a body weight or a caliber measurement.
